articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Robot maker Unitree’s IPO surges 600%, outpacing crypto traders’ premarket bets
articles.description: A Hyperliquid perp priced Unitree far above its IPO valuation before Shanghai trading began, but the robot maker’s first public trade still opened roughly 75% above crypto traders’ implied price.

articles.title: MAYAChain halts network after estimated $1.7M exploit
articles.description: A preliminary analysis says six chained bugs let a 23-message transaction drain 48.87 million CACAO, sending the token down nearly 89%.

articles.title: Solana leads bitcoin and ether higher while Korean chip stocks slide 7%
articles.description: Bitcoin held near $64,000 and every major except BNB gained, while Korean semiconductor stocks fell more than 7% and Fed minutes are due at 2 p.m. ET.

articles.title: US accounting board FASB proposes conditions for stablecoins as cash equivalents
articles.description: The FASB said secondary-market liquidity alone would not be enough, with holders needing direct issuer redemption rights and one-to-one liquid reserves.

articles.title: Trump pauses 50% scheduled tariffs on Canada for three days, announces 'deal' with Ottawa
articles.description: Trump has already imposed a variety of tariffs on Canada and its specific exports, including metals, lumber and auto parts.

articles.title: Seoul, Washington to halve joint drills as Trump reportedly seeks summit with North Korea's Kim
articles.description: Seoul, Washington to halve joint drills as Trump reportedly seeks summit with North Korea's Kim

articles.title: China’s backflipping robot maker Unitree pops 542% in Shanghai debut
articles.description: Unitree Robotics shares rise 542% on their first day of trading in Shanghai

articles.title: ‘It has to pass’: Andrew Cuomo warns U.S. is falling behind on crypto rules
articles.description: Former New York Gov. Andrew Cuomo says the CLARITY Act is key to linking crypto and traditional markets.

articles.title: California AG Bonta says case against Meta is about 'restitution and distortion,' not damages
articles.description: Following opening arguments in the case against Meta, California Attorney General Bonta said the trial is not about extracting a massive payout.

articles.title: What Chinese liquor maker Moutai's slump says about the country's economy
articles.description: Kweichow Moutai's half-year report showed a rare drop in net profit, following the first annual drop on record.

articles.title: Nukes all around? A fraying U.S. nuclear umbrella is pushing allies to weigh defense options, raising risk of a proliferation cascade
articles.description: As countries take more responsibility for their own defense and nuclear states step back from arms-control commitments, the question of proliferation arises.

articles.title: Robinhood CEO urges U.S. to clear path for tokenized stocks as overseas markets advance
articles.description: Vlad Tenev says tokenized stocks could bring real-time settlement and 24/7 trading, but U.S. rules remain a hurdle.

articles.title: Pennsylvania Cracks Down on AI Data Centers as Backlash Grows
articles.description: Gov. Josh Shapiro ordered new restrictions on large data centers aimed at shielding residents from higher electricity costs and giving communities more control over proposed projects.

articles.title: OpenAI rolls out ChatGPT for Teens experience with 'stronger built-in safety protections'
articles.description: ChatGPT for Teens includes a number of educational features and applies age-appropriate safeguards, OpenAI said.

articles.title: Mozilla Tests an AI 'Smart Window' in Firefox—But Only If You Opt In
articles.description: The optional window puts an assistant of your choice next to your tabs, with a switch to disable it.

articles.title: Rare Books Traced to Amazon AI Training Facility to Be Scanned and Destroyed
articles.description: A tracking device planted in a book order ended at a Las Vegas facility where Amazon strips bindings to scan pages for training data.

articles.title: Lakers governor Jeanie Buss says siblings cannot sell family’s stake to Bob Iger, Joshua Kushner
articles.description: Jeanie Buss's lawyer says she has not agreed to sell the team and that any vote suggesting the Buss family is selling "would be and is void."

articles.title: U.S. accounting-standards group proposes way to see stablecoins as 'cash equivalent'
articles.description: The Financial Accounting Standards Board, a nonprofit that governs accounting practices, proposed that certain stablecoins should fit the bill as cash-like.

articles.title: SEC proposes new crypto rules in absence of CLARITY Act
articles.description: The proposed rules from the US securities regulator would provide companies with a safe harbor from tokens being treated as “investment contracts” and certain exemptions for token issuance.
